title: Per-path cost and latency harmonizer: deterministic attribution for multi-tenant routes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a backend service and pipeline that produces deterministic per-route / per-model / per-customer cost and latency breakdowns by reconstructing request execution paths across streaming telemetry, batching windows, and KV-cache hits. The service will replace ad-hoc heuristics with a reproducible attribution algorithm that accounts for shared GPU batch costs, prefix/KV cache amortization, retries, and fallbacks. Deliverables: (1) a proto + runner that streams enriched traces into the aggregator, (2) a reconciliation job for late-arriving telemetry, (3) a runtime library for tagging requests with path identifiers, and (4) dashboards + APIs for the Console to consume the harmonized breakdowns.
acceptance_criteria: Service produces deterministic per-route/per-model/per-customer breakdowns for 95% of traffic during a 24h window
End-to-end latency attribution error (compared to raw trace CPU/GPU time) < 5% on sampled workloads
Reconciliation job corrects >99% of mismatches caused by late telemetry within 7 days
Console dashboards can render breakdowns for a single customer and a single route with <=500ms query latency on production cluster
success_metrics: Percent of requests with fully-attributed cost/latency >= 95%
Reduction in manual chargeback disputes by 80% for pilot customers
Median console query latency for harmonized views < 400ms
comments: 2026-02-11 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff complete. Agreed to use typed path IDs (path_id) emitted at ingress and propagated through runtime. Decided to prototype attribution in ClickHouse for fast iteration.

2026-02-22 - Marcus Li: Prototype shows stable batch-splitting attribution for GPU pools with homogeneous batch sizes. Observed edge cases where shared prefix cache (KV) hit causes negative per-request cost; added amortization heuristic to avoid negatives.

2026-03-02 - Eng review: Reviewed with runtime team. Action items: (1) add path_id propagation to async fallback paths, (2) include kernel-level timing tags from serving runtime, (3) add deterministic tie-breaker for simultaneous cache hits.

2026-03-08 - Marcus Li: Reconciliation job design uploaded. It consumes raw telemetry and reconciles through three steps: join traces by request_id, rehydrate batching windows using event timestamps, and backfill amortized KV savings across path members.

2026-03-10 - PM feedback (Sofia García): Pilot customers flagged desire for per-model-variant breakout and an exportable CSV of the reconciled ledger. Added to scope as optional bonus if ETA unaffected.
2026-03-12 - Marcus Li: Starting canary ingestion for pilot tenant 'acme-ml' at 10% traffic. Monitoring dashboards created to track attribution coverage and reconciliation drift.
